binding.selection: Use only when the approved content decision selects FAQ; never combine with GTK.
binding.count: One row per approved question/answer, no fixed required count and no filler. Clone the row using a DOM parser, numbering data-faq-item and text-slot suffixes 01,02,...; update each input id and corresponding label for to unique uid-faq-NN values.
binding.text: Set textContent from exact approved FAQ copy. No product claims are supplied by this layout. Preserve line breaks in copy with DOM text nodes, not untrusted HTML.
binding.review_state: Keep every checkbox checked so ALL answers are expanded before screenshot/export. Reopen all answers after any interactive inspection.
binding.assets: No GTK images or checkmarks in FAQ mode. Other asset/text slots are unchanged.
binding.provenance: FAQ structure reconstructed against verified live store CSS; no claim of captured live FAQ DOM or screenshot parity.
